Appearance:
 Shri Rajeev Sharma - Advocate for the petitioner.
 Shri Aps Tomar - Govt. Advocate for the respondent/Sta
 Order
Shri Prakash Singh SDO (P), Ambah, Distt. Morena is present in person.

Present petition under Section 482 of CrPC has been filed for issuance of directions to the respondents to conduct fair and impartial investigation and for initiation of proceeding under Section 82 and 83 of Cr.P.C. in Crime No. 12 of 2024 registered at Police Station Porsa District Morena (M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 304-B, 498A, 34 of IPC and for arresting the accused persons.

Learned counsel for the petitioner contends that the investigating agency is not conducting the investigation in fair and impartial manner, therefore, respondents - authorities be directed to conduct the fair and impartial investigation in aforementioned crime number.

On the other hand,
learned Govt. Advocate submits that status report has been filed and informed this Court that Charge-sheet has been filed against accused persons and proceedings u/s. 82 and 83 of Cr.P.C has been initiated against absconding accused person.

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the available record.

Considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties this petition is disposed of with the expectation that police shall ensure free and fair investigation in respect to the absconding accused person and shall deal with the matter in accordance with law.
No further order can be issued in the facts and circumstances of the case.
